text.p: Riga Transport Fleet said on Monday it plans $1.48 million in 1997 profit and may consider adding more medium-size multi-purpose reefers to its fleet later this year.
"The company management presented a forecast of 1997 figures to the shareholder meeting including a profit after tax of $1.48 million," Antonina Burgelis, RTF's chief accountant, told Reuters.

She said that the Saturday shareholder meeting also approved plans for a gross profit of $9.88 million and expenses of $7.24 million. Some $667,000 will cover administrative expenses and $1.67 million will go to interest payment.
Some $4.81 will be accumulated for depreciation.
"It is possible that the company may consider buying some ships this year but this depends very much on the first half-year results," Burgelis said.
"Some of the $4.81 million could be spent buying medium-size multi-purpose ships," she added.
RTF said that it was satisfied with the four ships it bought last year.
"Low operational costs and no travel without cargo means they are chartered most of the time," Burgelis said.
RTF also said, that it will cover its last bad debts, accumulated during 1993 and 1994, worth $470,264.
The company will also pay one santime in dividends.
